ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Old Keys
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has kept the colony's stores for two years now, and knows what is on every shelf without looking. The colony has taken to calling {PAWN_objective} Old Keys.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Old Furrow
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Two years as reeve, and {PAWN_nameDef} has walked every field at first light on nearly every one of those days. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} Old Furrow now.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Drover
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has kept the colony's herd for two years, and the animals come to {PAWN_possessive} call before anyone else's. People have started calling {PAWN_objective} the Drover.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Host
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Two years as steward: the suppers planned, the feasts laid, the long evenings kept going. The colony calls {PAWN_nameDef} the Host.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Old Voice
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has sat as an elder of the council for two years, and when {PAWN_pronoun} speaks at a meeting the room goes quiet. People call {PAWN_objective} the Old Voice.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Word-Kept
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Twice {PAWN_nameDef} has promised the colony something to win a seat, and twice the year showed it kept. People have started calling {PAWN_objective} Word-Kept.
